iterations.label: Resident Agent Widget Foundation
iterations.goal: Continue development of the Tauri desktop Codex-style resident agent widget through vibe-doctor sprints.
iterations.summary: The MVP shell, UI, and daemon stream exist. Next work should harden auth architecture and replace provider stubs with real integrations.

iterations.label: Resident Runtime Expansion
iterations.goal: Expand the widget beyond one-off UI patches into a durable resident desktop Codex assistant with stable app-server protocol, interaction UI, persistent conversation state, provider contracts, and desktop operations hardening.
iterations.carryover: Iter-1 delivered the Tauri shell, Codex auth, streaming conversation UX, and app-server default runtime. Open carryover: app-server approvals/user input, real DOM/Vision/PTY providers, report/milestone files, and resident desktop ops.
openRisks: Codex app-server protocol is experimental; keep exec fallback available.
Final browser store account submission requires an external Chrome Web Store or Microsoft Edge Add-ons dashboard action before live readiness can be marked complete.
iterations.summary: Iteration 2 has added runtime protocol durability, app-server interaction UI, app-server start/error diagnostics, fake app-server protocol smoke coverage for thread reuse/approval/rollback, optional live app-server smoke coverage for real CLI protocol drift, visible chat persistence, app-server-backed regenerate rollback, branch-safe session reset with one-shot branch context, reconnect response snapshot replay, renderer chat layout hardening with a Playwright smoke, provider status events, runtime health status, DOM snapshot ingress, an unpacked and zip-packaged browser DOM extension with local-only Options URL configuration plus an optional Chrome/Edge native messaging host and store-readiness metadata, Screen/Vision snapshot ingress, direct app-server Vision image input, a daemon-triggered Windows screen capture helper with Settings/env/visual-drag configured crop, optional OCR command support, OCR-only PNG preprocessing, image hash/change/diff metadata with configurable thresholding, bundled OCR runtime packaging, standard Windows Tesseract discovery/search roots, tessdata language acquisition, and bundled tessdata language defaults, explicit one-shot terminal execution, a persistent node-pty/ConPTY-backed /pty command/raw-input session, raw-input output drain, a renderer PTY viewport with terminal output accumulation, quick actions, and direct input controls, start-at-login settings, tray-oriented hide behavior, packaged-app daemon restart supervision with capped backoff, daemon parent-watchdog cleanup, renderer-visible native daemon diagnostics, bundled daemon JS, Node runtime, and PTY runtime resources for installed builds, installed `_up_` resource resolution, release exe launch smoke, NSIS install/uninstall plus daemon/app crash cleanup smoke, MSI install/launch/uninstall smoke, one-command release verification, release readiness audit, release exe longer soak with JSON evidence reports, serial smoke readiness gates, resident resource/soak smokes, a passed two-hour release soak, verified release installer builds, and a source-controlled browser store submission runbook. Final browser store account submission is the only known live-readiness blocker.
